description: This file contains an abstract class for running programmatic stream subscription tests in Orleans, along with a subscription management utility class. It defines multiple test cases for subscribing, unsubscribing, retrieving subscriptions, and handling multiple streams and providers within Orleans streaming tests.

classes.name: ProgrammaticSubscribeTestsRunner
classes.description: Abstract class providing setup and test methods for programmatic stream subscription testing in Orleans, including subscribing, unsubscribing, and verifying subscriptions and stream activity.

classes.name: SubscriptionManager
classes.description: Utility class to manage stream subscriptions within a test cluster, allowing setup, addition, retrieval, and removal of stream subscriptions for specific stream identities.

methods.name: Programmatic_Subscribe_Provider_WithExplicitPubsub_TryGetStreamSubscrptionManager
methods.description: Test that verifies subscription manager can be obtained and used for a specific stream provider.

methods.name: Programmatic_Subscribe_CanUseNullNamespace
methods.description: Test that adds and removes a subscription with a null namespace in the stream identity.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_Subscribe
methods.description: Test for setting up a streaming subscription, starting a producer, waiting for production, and verifying consumption by multiple grains.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_UnSubscribe
methods.description: Test that removes a subscription mid-stream, verifies production and consumption, and checks that unsubscribed consumers receive fewer messages.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_GetSubscriptions
methods.description: Test that verifies retrieval of current subscriptions, addition, and removal of subscriptions, ensuring the subscription list updates accordingly.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_ConsumerUnsubscribeOnAdd
methods.description: Test that verifies consumer grains are unsubscribed after a certain number of subscriptions are added.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_SubscribeToTwoStream_MessageWithPolymorphism
methods.description: Test that verifies multiple streams, including different message types, can be consumed by the same grains.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_SubscribeToStreamsHandledByDifferentStreamProvider
methods.description: Test that ensures streams from different stream providers can be handled and consumed correctly.

methods.name: ProducerHasProducedSinceLastCheck
methods.description: Utility method that checks if a producer has produced more items since a previous check.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Utility method that verifies if the number of produced messages equals the number of consumed messages.
